description: Headband sprinter crouched at the start, fingertips on the ground and one knee forward; nine-athlete idle concept.
Sprinter thinking with one hand at the chin, the other arm folded, and three overhead dots; dedicated lead THINK concept.
Headband sprinter leaning into a long running stride, rounded pumping fists and four speed dashes; dedicated lead WORK concept.
Sprinter standing with one closed hand raised and an exclamation mark above the head; dedicated lead WAIT concept.
Sprinter crossing a green waving finish tape, both fists raised and one heel kicked back; dedicated lead DONE concept.
Derived recovery pose: headband sprinter bent forward with hands braced on knees, preserving the lead singlet, shorts and trainers.
Swimmer upright in cap and goggles, scoop-neck swimsuit with briefs and long bare legs; nine-athlete idle concept.
Capped swimmer diving diagonally down toward two wave lines with pointed hands and trailing motion marks; action-four EXPLORE concept.
Ponytailed archer aiming a drawn bow, wearing a crossed strap, fitted top, shorts and boots; nine-athlete idle concept.
Archer releasing an arrow with a fully extended bow arm, wide stance and small motion ticks; action-four PLAN concept.
Curly-haired hurdler suspended above a rectangular hurdle, lead leg extended and trail leg tucked; nine-athlete idle concept.
Derived hurdler clearance with a straighter lead leg and swept trailing leg; keeps the idle curls, vest, shorts, trainers and hurdle.
Cap-wearing coach with a tilted clipboard at one hip and whistle hanging from a V-shaped lanyard; nine-athlete idle concept.
Derived coach directing left with an outstretched arm, retaining the cap, lanyard whistle, shorts and clipboard from idle.
Striped referee holding a raised scorecard showing an outlined 10, with the free arm relaxed; nine-athlete idle concept.
Derived referee announcing the score with the free arm extended, retaining the raised 10 card, headband and striped shirt.
Bun-haired gymnast in a leotard, arms outstretched horizontally and ankles together on a balance beam; nine-athlete idle concept.
Bun-haired gymnast balancing on one leg with the other extended to the side, arms horizontal and small balance ticks; action-four STATUS concept.
Relay runner holding a baton upright with one bent arm; scoop-neck singlet, shorts, knee details and lace-up trainers; nine-athlete idle concept.
Derived relay stride with baton reaching forward for a handoff; retains idle hair, scoop-neck singlet, shorts and trainers.
Weightlifter holding a loaded bar overhead in a low bent-knee stance, with scoop-neck singlet and boots; nine-athlete idle concept.
Weightlifter pressing the loaded bar overhead in a wide straight-leg stance, headband, singlet, shorts and effort ticks; action-four OTHER concept.
